_meta.source: US EPA PFAS Analyte List (Appendix B of Part II, epa.gov/system/files/documents/2024-05/pfas-analyte-list.pdf) used as a real, citable, CAS-verified enumeration of named PFAS -- ECHA's own REACH Annex XVII PFAS restriction dossier does not publish an enumerated CAS list, since it defines PFAS structurally (any substance containing at least one fully fluorinated methyl or methylene carbon atom). The ~14,000-substance figure quoted in ECHA's impact assessment is an estimate under that structural definition, not a downloadable list -- so this file is a real, verified, named-substance subset (40 entries) rather than a fabricated attempt at the full structural universe. `pfas_structural_flag` is true for every entry, and is also the field the Neo4j multi-hop query uses to catch PFAS substances that are NOT in this named list but match the structural definition (set at ingestion time by a simple heuristic: CAS/name contains 'perfluoro', 'polyfluoro', or a fluorotelomer/FTOH/FTS naming pattern).

regulation_status.name: PFAS_RESTRICTION_DRAFT
regulation_status.legal_ref: Draft amendment to REACH Annex XVII (Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006), restriction dossier submitted by five Member State authorities (Germany, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden, Norway) plus ECHA

timeline.event: Restriction proposal submitted; first public consultation opened (closed 2023-09-25, ~5,600 comments)
Updated PFAS Background Document published, narrowing scope and revising thresholds
ECHA Risk Assessment Committee (RAC) adopted its opinion
ECHA Socio-Economic Analysis Committee (SEAC) agreed its draft opinion
Second public consultation opened on SEAC's draft opinion (closed 2026-05-25)
SEAC expected to adopt its final opinion
European Commission drafts formal restriction decision with Member States for a REACH Committee vote; a final Annex XVII entry is not expected before 2027

regulation_status.status_as_of: 2026-07-05: in 2nd public consultation / committee-opinion stage, not yet a final legal restriction -- screening against it is a forward-looking readiness check, not an enforcement of current law.

proposed_thresholds.method: targeted analysis; polymeric PFAS excluded from quantification
targeted analysis, sum of quantifiable PFAS; pre-degradation of precursors optional; polymeric PFAS excluded
total fluorine / total PFAS content including polymeric PFAS; total-fluorine screening trigger at 50 mg F/kg requires the manufacturer/importer to show the fluorine is not PFAS-derived

derogation_pathways.description: Full ban with an 18-month transition period
Time-limited use-specific exemptions, 5-12 years depending on sector viability and availability of alternatives
